research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: BluumBio is researching and developing variant cytochrome P450 monooxygenases and uses thereof, focusing on bio-based technologies for the remediation of crude oil, PFAs, PCBs, and other organo-halides. The work includes polynucleotides encoding these enzymes, host cells expressing them, and methods for their application in cleaning soil, air, and water. These efforts highlight BluumBio’s focus on enzymatic solutions for environmental remediation.
